text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $63,900 while Ethereum is showing relative strength with a small gain, suggesting modest differentiation in risk appetite rather than broad capitulation. The Fear & Greed index at 26 indicates genuine caution, though the 3-point uptick over the week hints at a potential early stabilization. Bitcoin's dominance at 56.3% and moderate volume of $48B reflect a market that is neither panicked nor enthusiastic—traders are watching rather than committing heavily in either direction.
